PROVED 2026-09-08. THE SEAL SNAPSHOTS THE INSTANCE ROOT ONCE PER BATCH AND LEAVES THE TRAIL TREE EMPTY. Measured before, by running HEAD's own snapshot code rather than remembering: two full copies per sealed proof, 888.7MB / 9.28s / 163,352 entries. After, same box same minute: 118.0MB / 0.34s / 3,620 entries for a batch's first proof, 0.09s for every proof after it. Three changes, each with its own tooth: the trail tree arrives EMPTY BUT PRESENT (73% of the bytes; the directory must survive or check_instance_seal reads INDETERMINATE), the live root is read once per PROCESS with the pristine invalidated on the top-level NAME SET, and one copy per proof instead of two (the probe clears its own marker). The cost rides evidence.instance_seal.scratch on every seal — apparent bytes AND disk bytes AND entry count, because the old snapshot was 136MB of content in 424MB of 4KB blocks. That IS this ticket's watch, which is why watchme is 'none, because ...' and now true.

AND A BUG THIS VOYAGE UNCOVERED IS FIXED IN IT, by ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage (Akien: 'we are just going to attach that to the same ticket as a bug we fix with it', confirmed 'agreed on all counts. ruled approved and boogied'). The re-seal sweep read 200 proofs, 192 green, 8 red; attribution was MEASURED — the tree was stashed, HEAD confirmed to carry the old isolation.py, and 7 of the 8 are red at HEAD too. The eighth was a HOLLOW GREEN the emptier sandbox exposed: inference_domain's probe resolved its trail through two doors and only one followed the device, so its tooth had been passing on the live trail's borrowed lines rather than on the line it wrote, and its bound (>= 1) was met by either trail. FIXED AT THE BASE CLASS, where it cannot come back: DiagnosticBase gained diagnostic_records() beside diagnostic_trail() — WHERE and WHAT are now one answer, both carrying the device's roots — inference_domain passes it through, the probe builds no address of its own, and the tooth's bound is == 1. Four new teeth in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_device_logs_unwired.py hold the shape, and all bite under mutation. Trouble an-inference-call-probe-reads-two-different-trails cleared through its door.

THE BOUNDS MOVED BY RULING AND THE CHART BERTHS DID NOT. Rewriting constrain's bounds.in after the fact would make the record lie about what the chart knew on the day it was charted; the widening is recorded forward, in the ruling and in the verdict artifact's findings.
